title: Audentes SK/Tallinna Ulikool/TSK celebrate U18 title
description: Audentes SK/Tallinna Ulikool/TSK celebrated U18 title in the country. In the Final game they edged SK Nord Aid/Cramo 76-61. Oliver Mets (2004) stepped up with 14 points and Andre Rasmus (188-G-2004) scored 13. Patrick Malm (194-G-2004) and Gerrit Lehe (197-G-2005) ended up with 11 points each in a win. Sander Jarve (198-F-2004) replied with 16 points in a loss. Simm-Marten Saadi (203-F-2005) produced 15 and Gregor Allik (190-G-2004) had 13.
